productionDesignTarget.note: Existing unaccepted package; classify and validate its director-facing target when reopened.

sourceEvidence.provenance: Official LEGO 4910 instruction PDF page 1; unmodified full-page raster retained in the unit-specific source manifest.

productionDesignTarget.rationale: Official LEGO 4910 completed Scout at instruction step 7, framed directly from the official page; no new exterior geometry.
productionDesignTarget.appearanceSummary: Build the open low plate sled shown at official 4910 instruction step 7: seated blue/turquoise operator, large forward angular scanner/tool assembly, exposed deck and separate rear tool rack; no closed hull, invented sensor tower or added underside hero mass.

assets.acceptanceNote: Директор затвердив через «+» 2026-09-24: офіційний LEGO 4910, крок 7; дозволені лише низький зазор зависання, короткий сигнал від штатної передньої сканерно-інструментальної збірки та мала пласка командна мітка.

productionDesignTarget.rationale: Completed LEGO 1277 step 6 already represents the intended external appearance; target is a source-pixel crop with no new concept or exterior geometry.
productionDesignTarget.appearanceSummary: Completed 1277 Hovercraft with Ice Saws: low open plate-built sled, exposed operator, central hazard panel, yellow sloped sides, turquoise grilles, paired raised round side pods and two narrow elongated forward saw bars; no central helical drill or added enclosure.

sourceEvidence.provenance: Archive-hosted scan of the official LEGO 1277 instruction page; unmodified source raster and hash recorded.

assets.acceptanceNote: The director accepted the completed LEGO 1277 SOURCE_LOCKED exterior on 2026-09-24; T084 is authorized but has not started.

sourceEvidence.provenance: Official LEGO 4920 instruction PDF pages 1–2; both unmodified full-page rasters and PDF hash recorded in the unit-specific source manifest.

productionDesignTarget.rationale: The official completed LEGO 4920 already represents the intended exterior; preserve its one-driver appearance and source proportions.
productionDesignTarget.appearanceSummary: Official completed LEGO 4920 Rapid Rider, preserving the twin-hull exterior, source proportions, open cargo tub and one source-scale driver; no added passenger seating or visible exterior adaptation.

assets.acceptanceNote: Директор відхилив ADAPTED-ціль із чотирма Crew та затвердив SOURCE_LOCKED вигляд офіційного LEGO 4920 з одним водієм і джерельними пропорціями. Вигляд додаткового пасажира чи альтернативного вантажу відкладено; місткість гри не змінюється.

sourceEvidence.provenance: Official LEGO 4950 instruction PDF 4128419; unmodified page 1 plus construction pages 21–22, hashes recorded in the source manifest.

productionDesignTarget.rationale: The official completed LEGO 4950 already shows the intended base appearance with its bucket; the researched Cutter Package is a separate game upgrade, not the base target.
productionDesignTarget.appearanceSummary: Official completed LEGO 4950 Loader Dozer: low gray chassis, four large black wheels, open brown operator cage, turquoise/yellow details and full-width front bucket; no visible game-specific geometry changes.

assets.acceptanceNote: Director approved the official LEGO 4950 SOURCE_LOCKED base appearance with its bucket on 2026-09-24. The researched Cutter Package remains a separate game upgrade; its fitted appearance is not authorized by this target.

productionDesignTarget.rationale: Completed official LEGO 4940 already represents the intended exterior; instruction page 1 is the target and page 24 provides construction evidence.
productionDesignTarget.appearanceSummary: Completed official LEGO 4940 Granite Grinder: tall narrow walker on two separated ski feet, high open brown operator cage, long pale forward drill, gray and dark mechanism, turquoise/yellow accents, hazard bands and short rear equipment mass; no static geometry adaptation.

sourceEvidence.provenance: Official LEGO 4940 instruction PDF 4128317.pdf; unmodified full-page rasters and source PDF SHA-256 are recorded in the unit-specific source evidence manifest.

assets.acceptanceNote: Director approved the SOURCE_LOCKED official LEGO 4940 appearance with restrained short alternating steps on 2026-09-24. T084 is authorized for this unit only and has not started.
gameAdaptations: Restrained alternating short steps with low foot lift and minimal upper-body sway; presentation interpretation only because the LEGO instructions do not demonstrate gait.

productionDesignTarget.rationale: Official LEGO 4970 is the target image; the director accepted its one small game-specific team marker.
productionDesignTarget.appearanceSummary: Official LEGO 4970 long open frame, four large wheels, offset powered drill, operator cage, open service area and raised work beam; one small flat team marker is the only visible game adaptation.

assets.acceptanceNote: Director approved the official LEGO 4970 SOURCE_LOCKED Production Design Target with one small flat team marker on the outer central frame. No other visible geometry or color adaptation. T084 is authorized for this unit only and has not started.
gameAdaptations: One small flat team marker on the outside of the central frame above the rear wheel pair.

productionDesignTarget.rationale: Director approved the existing adapted loaded appearance: preserve the open LEGO 4980 lift frame and show one separate full-size Chrome Crusher on a lower frame-supported yoke.
productionDesignTarget.appearanceSummary: Open 4980 twin-rotor load bridge with source brown blades, gray/white crossbeam, turquoise/yellow accents and forward control module; one separate horizontal 4970 Chrome Crusher hangs below the central frame on a lower yoke. No enclosed fuselage, altered rotor geometry or extra game units.

sourceEvidence.provenance: Official LEGO instructions, PDF SHA-256 and exact page-image hashes recorded in the unit-specific source evidence manifest.

gameAdaptations: One open lower cargo yoke with paired short hangers attached only to the central load-bearing frame; it carries one unchanged, separate Chrome Crusher horizontally below the frame.
assets.acceptanceNote: Director approved on 2026-09-24. T084 is authorized for Tunnel Transport only; it has not started.

productionDesignTarget.note: Accepted before the target gate; preserve accepted decision without automatic invalidation.

assets.acceptanceNote: Director accepted the official LEGO 7301 SOURCE_LOCKED target after the antenna/mast wording was corrected to follow the source image without interpreting its terminal shape.

productionDesignTarget.appearanceSummary: Official LEGO 7301 page 1 completed Rover: very small compact open vehicle, four dominant white half-dome wheels, light chassis, seated astronaut, black front boom and short black dish mast; no large blue equipment box.

gameAdaptations: Restrained temporary survey pulse at the source front boom tip; presentation effect only.
